camera.pauseBlend: QuadOut composed three times; unpause blend=(1-zoomT)^8; zoomT += 2*deltaTime after one skipped Leave delta
camera.rasterMethod: Bounding box, exclusive max edges, of RGB pixels with B>=100, B>G+20, G>R+20. Interior blue board ink only; not Draw.blockWidthLast, border bounds or private camera flags.
limitations: cameraUnpause, cameraUnpauseIgnoreOneDelta, zoomT and blockWidthLast are not present in V14 phase telemetry.
Camera mathematical rule is source-derived; PNG growth/one equal frame is corroboration, not a direct flag measurement.
No pixel-perfect Web camera comparison is included.

Only keyboard-mask RIGHT twice and DOWN once at first portal are observed; UP, LEFT, simultaneous directions, key release at exact boundary, QUICK_ANIM, mobile, Title and active camera moves are unsupported.
Observer delivers effective Controls masks; not OS physical-key timing.
